title: Analysis code for: A targeted nanopore amplicon sequencing panel for identification of six Anopheles species, with an evaluation of integrated Plasmodium detection

creators.name: Guya, Cyprian Adala
creators.affiliation: Jaramogi Oginga Odinga University of Science and Technology; Kenya Medical Research Institute

creators.name: Hendry, Jason
creators.affiliation: Max Planck Institute for Infection Biology

description: Scripts, small input files and summary tables for the Anopheles species-identification and Plasmodium detection nanopore amplicon panel manuscript (submitted to BMC Genomics). Results are for the 349-specimen evaluation set (374 sequenced; 25 excluded by quality control), including run, carry-over and background quality-control checks. Sequence data: NCBI SRA BioProject PRJNA1517867.
